title: Quadratic simulation time bound
statement: For all natural numbers $k,t$, the recursively defined time function satisfies $\sigma_k(t)\leq (9k+6)(t+1)^2$.
replaced:
The function $\sigma_k$ defined by $\sigma_k(0) = 2k+2$ and
$\sigma_k(t+1) = \sigma_k(t) + (4t+7)k + 4$ satisfies
$\sigma_k(t) \le (9k+6)(t+1)^2$ for all $k, t \in \mathbb{N}$.
